Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.evaporation

Class PipelineEvaporationResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.evaporation.PipelineEvaporationResult
Direct Known Subclasses:
PipelineDissolutionResult
public class PipelineEvaporationResult extends Object
Result of an axial pipeline evaporation study, with generic aliases used by gas dissolution.
